references.text: Moses again warns the people not to forget the Lord after they have eaten and are full, reminding them that the Lord brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Warning about the consequences of forgetting your God and following other gods.
God presents himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; the same wording is used here.
Moses urges the people to remember this day when they went out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
The introduction to the Ten Commandments where God reminds them that he brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Joshua reminds the people that the Lord brought them and their fathers out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
The Lord reminds Israel that he brought them up from Egypt and saved them from the house of slavery, and warns against fearing other gods.
Hosea speaks about how Israel should know no other God than the Lord who brought them out of Egypt, and warns against forgetting him when they become full.
